description_en: Grants permissions on databases and database accounts to a user group
description_zh: 为用户组授权数据库及数据库账户
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-database-accounts-to-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zvp282aly06 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 2 --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"58","DatabaseAccountIds":["1"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDatabaseAccountsToUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user group to which to grant the permissions
parameters.name: user_group_id

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the database instance on which you want to grant permissions
element_fields.help_zh: 要授权的数据库实例 ID
element_fields.name: database_id

element_fields.help_en: An array of database account IDs
element_fields.name: database_account_ids

parameters.help_en:
An array of database objects.

You can specify up to 10 databases and 10 database accounts. If you do not specify any database accounts, permissions are granted on the entire database
parameters.help_zh:
数据库对象数组。
最大数据库数10个，数据库账号数10个。允许不传账号，不传账号则代表授权到数据库
parameters.name: databases
